calculation_steps: Exact rational oriented D_k and K_k construction verifies Pk ranks6,6,2 and cross-projector zero.
Choose i=-J, t=tau0 s and chi external so Schr Hamiltonian is H_eff=(2chi/tau0)sum gk Pi_k, with complex eigenspace multiplicities 3,3,1.

Since at most three different g values, H_eff has at most three distinct energies and at most two nonzero ground transitions; at reference g1=g2=1,g3=1.5 there are only two distinct energies (2 sixfold, 3 once).
Check seven-state cyclic charge basis has [N,S]-S=-7|-3><3|; finite CCR trace obstruction independently follows.
Add conventional rotor operator H=4EC(N-ng)^2-ΣEJm cos(mφ) as an EXTERNAL new model and truncate to charge ±12 and ±16; NumPy numerical 7 lowest transitions converge better than 1e-7GHz.
Do not import actual Jülich transmon data or claim empirical regression; park direct model and enumerate changed-hypothesis quantum extensions.

counterexamples_and_failures: Fixed generator g=(1,1,3/2) gives sixfold ground-level degeneracy and one single excited energy; no six distinct f0j frequencies.
Any fixed three independent local gains still yield at most three distinct energy values, irrespective of clock/action scale.
Seven-state cyclic charge shift fails exact [N,S]=S by boundary rank1 defect; finite canonical CCR fails by trace.
Conventional rotor truncated numerically to 25/33 finite states gives approximate low-lying levels, so no-go not universal to finite approximations or arbitrary Hermitian 7x7.
